WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.MediaTypeId,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS FLOAT)) as bytes_per_ms
  FROM MediaType mt
  JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as threshold_bytes_per_ms
  FROM media_type_stats
),
filtered_media_types AS (
  SELECT 
    mts.avg_unit_price,
    mts.bytes_per_ms,
    t.threshold_bytes_per_ms
  FROM media_type_stats mts
  CROSS JOIN threshold t
  WHERE mts.bytes_per_ms > t.threshold_bytes_per_ms
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_unit_price),
  AVG(bytes_per_ms),
  AVG(bytes_per_ms - threshold_bytes_per_ms)
FROM filtered_media_types
